summary: Winmark filed an 8-K reporting Q3 results and declaring shareholder returns. The board approved a quarterly dividend of $1.02 per share plus a special dividend of $4.00 per share, both payable December 1, 2026 to holders of record November 11, 2026; the special dividend totals roughly $14.2 million. Separately, Winmark told franchisees it will create separate North American Ad Funds for Once Upon A Child and Play It Again Sports, requiring 2% of sales contributions from January 31, 2027. Watch payout sustainability and franchisee cost pushback.
